options.content:
Power Management System

Breakers, converters, switches and grids of the PMS, from the Marpower AMCS. Every section has a **Trends** tab with the history over the selected time range and a **Live** tab with the latest values. **Timelines** show each binary signal as on or off: red for alarms, green for status, blue for commands. **Live tables** use the same colors for signals that are on.

spec.title: AFT thruster main breakers
spec.description: F105 and F110 main breakers of the AFT thruster, from the DC distribution general table. Transitions only. Red: alarm, green: status, blue: command.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, "F105 Fault/trip", "F105 Open 1 (OF1)", "F105 Open 2 (OF2)", "F105 Open command" FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time,
    CAST(fault__value AS INT) AS "F105 Fault/trip", LAG(CAST(fault__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F105 Fault/trip",
    CAST(of_1_open__value AS INT) AS "F105 Open 1 (OF1)", LAG(CAST(of_1_open__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F105 Open 1 (OF1)",
    CAST(of_2_open__value AS INT) AS "F105 Open 2 (OF2)", LAG(CAST(of_2_open__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F105 Open 2 (OF2)",
    CAST(open_command__value AS INT) AS "F105 Open command", LAG(CAST(open_command__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F105 Open command"
  FROM public.marpower__dc_700v__breaker
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND technical_name = '13-11-f105'
) t
WHERE ("prev F105 Fault/trip" IS DISTINCT FROM "F105 Fault/trip")
  OR ("prev F105 Open 1 (OF1)" IS DISTINCT FROM "F105 Open 1 (OF1)")
  OR ("prev F105 Open 2 (OF2)" IS DISTINCT FROM "F105 Open 2 (OF2)")
  OR ("prev F105 Open command" IS DISTINCT FROM "F105 Open command")
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, "F110 Fault/trip", "F110 Open 1 (OF1)", "F110 Open 2 (OF2)", "F110 Open command" FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time,
    CAST(fault__value AS INT) AS "F110 Fault/trip", LAG(CAST(fault__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F110 Fault/trip",
    CAST(of_1_open__value AS INT) AS "F110 Open 1 (OF1)", LAG(CAST(of_1_open__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F110 Open 1 (OF1)",
    CAST(of_2_open__value AS INT) AS "F110 Open 2 (OF2)", LAG(CAST(of_2_open__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F110 Open 2 (OF2)",
    CAST(open_command__value AS INT) AS "F110 Open command", LAG(CAST(open_command__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev F110 Open command"
  FROM public.marpower__dc_700v__breaker
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND technical_name = '13-11-f110'
) t
WHERE ("prev F110 Fault/trip" IS DISTINCT FROM "F110 Fault/trip")
  OR ("prev F110 Open 1 (OF1)" IS DISTINCT FROM "F110 Open 1 (OF1)")
  OR ("prev F110 Open 2 (OF2)" IS DISTINCT FROM "F110 Open 2 (OF2)")
  OR ("prev F110 Open command" IS DISTINCT FROM "F110 Open command")
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Thruster main breakers
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest sample. Same sources as the trends of this section.

spec.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-11-f105' THEN fault__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-11-f105', timestamp) AS r0_0,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-11-f105' THEN of_1_open__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-11-f105', timestamp) AS r0_1,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-11-f105' THEN of_2_open__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-11-f105', timestamp) AS r0_2,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-11-f105' THEN open_command__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-11-f105', timestamp) AS r0_3,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-11-f110' THEN fault__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-11-f110', timestamp) AS r1_0,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-11-f110' THEN of_1_open__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-11-f110', timestamp) AS r1_1,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-11-f110' THEN of_2_open__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-11-f110', timestamp) AS r1_2,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-11-f110' THEN open_command__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-11-f110', timestamp) AS r1_3,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-31-f105' THEN fault__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-31-f105', timestamp) AS r2_0,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-31-f105' THEN of_1_open__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-31-f105', timestamp) AS r2_1,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-31-f105' THEN of_2_open__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-31-f105', timestamp) AS r2_2,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-31-f105' THEN open_command__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-31-f105', timestamp) AS r2_3,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-31-f110' THEN fault__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-31-f110', timestamp) AS r3_0,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-31-f110' THEN of_1_open__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-31-f110', timestamp) AS r3_1,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-31-f110' THEN of_2_open__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-31-f110', timestamp) AS r3_2,
    last_value(CASE WHEN technical_name = '13-31-f110' THEN open_command__value END ORDER BY technical_name = '13-31-f110', timestamp) AS r3_3,
    max(timestamp) AS updated
  FROM public.marpower__dc_700v__breaker WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window')
SELECT 'AFT F105' AS "Breaker", CAST(r0_0 AS INT) AS "Fault/trip", CAST(r0_1 AS INT) AS "Open 1 (OF1)", CAST(r0_2 AS INT) AS "Open 2 (OF2)", CAST(r0_3 AS INT) AS "Open command", to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(updated) AS "Updated" FROM latest
UNION ALL
SELECT 'AFT F110' AS "Breaker", CAST(r1_0 AS INT) AS "Fault/trip", CAST(r1_1 AS INT) AS "Open 1 (OF1)", CAST(r1_2 AS INT) AS "Open 2 (OF2)", CAST(r1_3 AS INT) AS "Open command", to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(updated) AS "Updated" FROM latest
UNION ALL

spec.title: Solar system 1
spec.description: Converter 04-31-t101 and Bender isolation monitor. Transitions only. Red: alarm, green: status, blue: command.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, "Converter Temp. warning 1", "Converter Temp. warning 2", "Converter Status OK", "Converter Enable", "Converter Safety disconnect" FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time,
    CAST(temperature_warning_1__value AS INT) AS "Converter Temp. warning 1", LAG(CAST(temperature_warning_1__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Converter Temp. warning 1",
    CAST(temperature_warning_2__value AS INT) AS "Converter Temp. warning 2", LAG(CAST(temperature_warning_2__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Converter Temp. warning 2",
    CAST(status_ok__value AS INT) AS "Converter Status OK", LAG(CAST(status_ok__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Converter Status OK",
    CAST(enable_disable__value AS INT) AS "Converter Enable", LAG(CAST(enable_disable__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Converter Enable",
    CAST(safety_disconnect__value AS INT) AS "Converter Safety disconnect", LAG(CAST(safety_disconnect__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Converter Safety disconnect"
  FROM public.marpower__solar__dc_dc_converter
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic = 'marpower/45-solar/dc-dc-converter/04-31-t101'
) t
WHERE ("prev Converter Temp. warning 1" IS DISTINCT FROM "Converter Temp. warning 1")
  OR ("prev Converter Temp. warning 2" IS DISTINCT FROM "Converter Temp. warning 2")
  OR ("prev Converter Status OK" IS DISTINCT FROM "Converter Status OK")
  OR ("prev Converter Enable" IS DISTINCT FROM "Converter Enable")
  OR ("prev Converter Safety disconnect" IS DISTINCT FROM "Converter Safety disconnect")
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, "Bender MF-DO output (M+)", "Bender DI/O output (Q)", "Bender Digital input (I)" FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time,
    CAST(multi_function_output__value AS INT) AS "Bender MF-DO output (M+)", LAG(CAST(multi_function_output__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Bender MF-DO output (M+)",
    CAST(digital_input_output__value AS INT) AS "Bender DI/O output (Q)", LAG(CAST(digital_input_output__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Bender DI/O output (Q)",
    CAST(digital_input__value AS INT) AS "Bender Digital input (I)", LAG(CAST(digital_input__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Bender Digital input (I)"

  OR ("prev Bender DI/O output (Q)" IS DISTINCT FROM "Bender DI/O output (Q)")
  OR ("prev Bender Digital input (I)" IS DISTINCT FROM "Bender Digital input (I)")

spec.title: Solar converters
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest sample. Same sources as the trends of this section.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CASE topic WHEN 'marpower/45-solar/dc-dc-converter/04-31-t101' THEN 'Solar 1' WHEN 'marpower/45-solar/dc-dc-converter/04-32-t101' THEN 'Solar 2.1' WHEN 'marpower/45-solar/dc-dc-converter/04-32-t102' THEN 'Solar 2.2' END AS "Converter",
  CAST(last_value(temperature_warning_1__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS INT) AS "Temp. warning 1",
  CAST(last_value(temperature_warning_2__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS INT) AS "Temp. warning 2",
  CAST(last_value(status_ok__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS INT) AS "Status OK",
  CAST(last_value(enable_disable__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS INT) AS "Enable",
  CAST(last_value(safety_disconnect__value ORDER BY timestamp) AS INT) AS "Safety disconnect",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(max(timestamp)) AS "Updated"
FROM public.marpower__solar__dc_dc_converter
WHERE timestamp > now() - INTERVAL '$live_window' AND topic IN ('marpower/45-solar/dc-dc-converter/04-31-t101', 'marpower/45-solar/dc-dc-converter/04-32-t101', 'marpower/45-solar/dc-dc-converter/04-32-t102')
GROUP BY topic ORDER BY 1

spec.title: DC switch 05.71

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time, "Tripped", "Opened", "Closed", "Running", "Open cmd", "Close cmd", "Reset cmd" FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS time,
    CAST(feedback_tripped__value AS INT) AS "Tripped", LAG(CAST(feedback_tripped__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Tripped",
    CAST(feedback_opened__value AS INT) AS "Opened", LAG(CAST(feedback_opened__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Opened",
    CAST(feedback_closed__value AS INT) AS "Closed", LAG(CAST(feedback_closed__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Closed",
    CAST(running__value AS INT) AS "Running", LAG(CAST(running__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Running",
    CAST(open__value AS INT) AS "Open cmd", LAG(CAST(open__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Open cmd",

    CAST(reset__value AS INT) AS "Reset cmd", LAG(CAST(reset__value AS INT)) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS "prev Reset cmd"
  FROM public.marpower__dc_700v__dc_switch
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND topic = 'marpower/45-dc-700v/dc-switch/05-71-q101'
) t
WHERE ("prev Tripped" IS DISTINCT FROM "Tripped")
  OR ("prev Opened" IS DISTINCT FROM "Opened")
  OR ("prev Closed" IS DISTINCT FROM "Closed")
  OR ("prev Running" IS DISTINCT FROM "Running")
  OR ("prev Open cmd" IS DISTINCT FROM "Open cmd")

spec.title: Status
spec.description: Breaker and synchronization status, and the uGrid's digital inputs. The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest sample. Same sources as the trends of this section.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT 'AFT' AS "uGrid",
  CAST(s0.c0 AS INT) AS "Auto mode",
  CAST(s0.c1 AS INT) AS "Breaker opened",
  CAST(s0.c2 AS INT) AS "Breaker closed",
  CAST(s0.c3 AS INT) AS "Sync device status",
  CAST(s0.c4 AS INT) AS "Sync speed up",
  CAST(s0.c5 AS INT) AS "Sync speed down",
  CAST(s0.c6 AS INT) AS "Rotating field",
  CAST(s1.c0 AS INT) AS "Digital input 1",
  CAST(s1.c1 AS INT) AS "Digital input 2",
  to_unixtime(now()) - to_unixtime(least(s0.updated, s1.updated)) AS "Updated"
FROM (SELECT last_value(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-ac-400v/distribution-board/10p0-1' THEN auto_mode__value END ORDER BY topic = 'marpower/45-ac-400v/distribution-board/10p0-1', timestamp) AS c0, last_value(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-ac-400v/breaker/10p0-1-100q01' THEN opened__value END ORDER BY topic = 'marpower/45-ac-400v/breaker/10p0-1-100q01', timestamp) AS c1, last_value(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-ac-400v/breaker/10p0-1-100q01' THEN closed__value END ORDER BY topic = 'marpower/45-ac-400v/breaker/10p0-1-100q01', timestamp) AS c2, last_value(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-ac-400v/synchroniser/10p0-1-100a01' THEN device_status__value END ORDER BY topic = 'marpower/45-ac-400v/synchroniser/10p0-1-100a01', timestamp) AS c3, last_value(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-ac-400v/synchroniser/10p0-1-100a01' THEN speed_up__value END ORDER BY topic = 'marpower/45-ac-400v/synchroniser/10p0-1-100a01', timestamp) AS c4, last_value(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-ac-400v/synchroniser/10p0-1-100a01' THEN speed_down__value END ORDER BY topic = 'marpower/45-ac-400v/synchroniser/10p0-1-100a01', timestamp) AS c5, last_value(CASE WHEN topic =   avg(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-dc-700v/temperature-sensor/01-36-r102' THEN temperature__value END) AS "SB02 FWD 2"

GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Switchboard temperatures
spec.description: The latest value within the live window ($live_window), independent of the selected time range; empty when nothing was published in that window. Updated: seconds since the latest sample. Same sources as the trends of this section.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT round(last_value(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-dc-350v/temperature-sensor/02-71-r102' THEN temperature__value END ORDER BY topic = 'marpower/45-dc-350v/temperature-sensor/02-71-r102', timestamp), 1) AS "SB08 [°C]",
  round(last_value(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-dc-700v/temperature-sensor/01-26-r101' THEN temperature__value END ORDER BY topic = 'marpower/45-dc-700v/temperature-sensor/01-26-r101', timestamp), 1) AS "MSB AFT 1 [°C]",
  round(last_value(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-dc-700v/temperature-sensor/01-26-r102' THEN temperature__value END ORDER BY topic = 'marpower/45-dc-700v/temperature-sensor/01-26-r102', timestamp), 1) AS "MSB AFT 2 [°C]",
  round(last_value(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-dc-700v/temperature-sensor/01-26-r103' THEN temperature__value END ORDER BY topic = 'marpower/45-dc-700v/temperature-sensor/01-26-r103', timestamp), 1) AS "MSB AFT 3 [°C]",
  round(last_value(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-dc-700v/temperature-sensor/01-26-r104' THEN temperature__value END ORDER BY topic = 'marpower/45-dc-700v/temperature-sensor/01-26-r104', timestamp), 1) AS "MSB AFT 4 [°C]",
  round(last_value(CASE WHEN topic = 'marpower/45-dc-700v/temperature-sensor/01-36-r101' THEN temperature__value END ORDER BY topic = 'marpower/45-dc-700v/temperature-sensor/01-36-r101', timestamp), 1) AS "SB02 FWD 1 [°C]",
